title: Necking bar UL closure
objective: Remove the deferred UL skip from the necking bar benchmark and complete its original TL/UL Hex8 scope.

plan_assets.asset_description: Phase E5 necking-bar original-scope closure requirements.

scope: Widen necking-bar benchmark behavior to original TL/UL Hex8 semantics.
Remove the UL skip from the necking-bar matrix test.
Preserve current TL benchmark defaults and tolerances.
implementation_steps: Run GitNexus impact on existing necking benchmark symbols before editing them.
Add a formulation selector or equivalent backward-compatible path.
Wire UL Hex8 J2 support through the Phase 2 solver layer.
Activate the UL necking-bar test case.
Run necking-specific and related benchmark tests.
deliverables: Active necking-bar matrix test without skips.
Updated local task/gate artifacts after execution.
acceptance_criteria: Necking tests have no UL skip.
TL necking reference behavior remains compatible.
UL necking result is finite and satisfies the original acceptance criteria.
risks: UL necking may be more nonlinear than the TL path; mitigate with smoke-sized load stepping before the full benchmark settings.
completion_notes: The explicit UL skip was removed from the necking matrix test.
NeckingBarParameters now accepts a formulation selector with the TL default preserved.
UL Hex8 reference coverage and UL finite J2 history smoke coverage are active.
